// Fixture guarding against false positives: a legitimate api/ package exposes only domain-shaped
// types and standard library values, and must produce no violations.
package api

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

type Repo struct {
	ID        string
	Name      string
	CreatedAt time.Time
}

type Reader interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (Repo, error)
}
